# Widget Meta-Language (WML) facility: generates the UIL compiler's language
# description (the Uil*.h tables) from motif.wml at build time.  The tools
# are not installed.
#
# The parser and scanner generators are found by the top-level
# motif_find_parser_generators().

# WML target files (generated by WML processing)
set(WML_TARGETS
    UilConst.h
    UilKeyTab.h
    UilSymArTa.h
    UilSymArTy.h
    UilSymCSet.h
    UilSymCtl.h
    UilSymEnum.h
    UilSymGen.h
    UilSymNam.h
    UilSymRArg.h
    UilSymReas.h
    UilTokName.h
    UilUrmClas.h
    UilSymChCl.h
    UilSymChTa.h
)
list(TRANSFORM WML_TARGETS PREPEND ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/)

# The tools that generate the tables (wml, wmluiltok) are imported from a
# native build when cross-compiling (MOTIF_HOST_TOOLS).
if(NOT MOTIF_HOST_TOOLS)

# Scanners.  wmlparse.y includes the generated wmllex.c.
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/wmllex.c
    COMMAND ${MOTIF_LEX_EXECUTABLE} -o wmllex.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/wmllex.l
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
    DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/wmllex.l
    COMMENT "Generating wmllex.c from wmllex.l"
    VERBATIM
)
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/wmluiltok.c
    COMMAND ${MOTIF_LEX_EXECUTABLE} -o wmluiltok.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/wmluiltok.l
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
    DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/wmluiltok.l
    COMMENT "Generating wmluiltok.c from wmluiltok.l"
    VERBATIM
)

# Parser
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/wmlparse.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/wmlparse.h
    COMMAND ${MOTIF_YACC_EXECUTABLE} -d -o wmlparse.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/wmlparse.y
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
    DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/wmlparse.y ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/wmllex.c
    COMMENT "Generating wmlparse.c and wmlparse.h from wmlparse.y"
    VERBATIM
)

# Build libwml static library
add_library(libwml STATIC
    wmloutkey.c
    wmlouth.c
    wmloutmm.c
    wmloutp1.c
    wmlresolve.c
    wmlsynbld.c
    wmlutils.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/wmlparse.c
)
set_target_properties(libwml PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME wml)
target_include_directories(libwml PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})
target_link_libraries(libwml PRIVATE motif_build_flags)

# Build wml executable
add_executable(wml wml.c)
target_link_libraries(wml PRIVATE libwml motif_build_flags)

# Build wmluiltok executable; wmluiltok.l has no main(), it comes from the
# lex library.
add_executable(wmluiltok ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/wmluiltok.c)
target_link_libraries(wmluiltok PRIVATE ${MOTIF_LEX_LIBRARY} motif_build_flags)

# The flex skeleton marks its fall-throughs with comments, which Clang
# does not take as annotations.  wmlparse.c includes wmllex.c.
set_source_files_properties(
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/wmlparse.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/wmluiltok.c
    PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS $<$<C_COMPILER_ID:Clang>:-Wno-implicit-fallthrough>
)

endif()

# Generate the UIL tables.  wmluiltok extracts the token list (tokens.dat)
# from the UIL grammar, which wml reads together with motif.wml.
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${WML_TARGETS}
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E remove -f ${WML_TARGETS} wml.report wml-uil.mm
    COMMAND ${MOTIF_TOOL_ENV} $<TARGET_FILE:${MOTIF_HOST_TOOL_PREFIX}wmluiltok> < ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/lib/Uil/Uil.y > tokens.dat
    COMMAND ${MOTIF_TOOL_ENV} $<TARGET_FILE:${MOTIF_HOST_TOOL_PREFIX}wml> ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/motif.wml
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E remove -f tokens.dat
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
    DEPENDS
        ${MOTIF_HOST_TOOL_PREFIX}wmluiltok
        ${MOTIF_HOST_TOOL_PREFIX}wml
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/motif.wml
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/lib/Uil/Uil.y
    COMMENT "Generating WML target files"
)

# Create a target for WML generated files
add_custom_target(wml_generated_files
    DEPENDS ${WML_TARGETS}
    COMMENT "WML generated files target"
)

# Build wmldbcreate executable, which writes the motif.wmd database
add_executable(wmldbcreate wmldbcreate.c)
target_link_libraries(wmldbcreate PRIVATE Xm)
target_include_directories(wmldbcreate PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/bin/uil
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/lib/Uil
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/src/lib/Uil
)
# Needs the UIL parser header (UilLexPars.h) and the WML tables
add_dependencies(wmldbcreate uil_parser_target wml_generated_files)

# motif.wmd database (not built by default)
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/motif.wmd
    COMMAND ${MOTIF_TOOL_ENV} $<TARGET_FILE:wmldbcreate> -o motif.wmd
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
    DEPENDS wmldbcreate ${WML_TARGETS}
    COMMENT "Generating motif.wmd database"
)
add_custom_target(wml_all
    DEPENDS ${WML_TARGETS} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/motif.wmd
    COMMENT "Building all WML generated files"
)
